eyebrow: Lesson 06 · B1 · Good Manners at School · 20 câu
heading: Classmates and Teachers
source: Bài đọc phỏng theo Good Manners at School – Ann Ingalls (The Child's World, 2013), tr. 8–11.
credit: Tranh minh hoạ: Ronnie Rooney, trong Good Manners at School (The Child's World, 2013). Dùng cho mục đích học tập.

paras.label: A
paras.text: Being kind to other students is one of the most important school manners. If you notice someone sitting alone, {invite|invite} them to join your group. A simple "Do you want to join us?" can make a big difference, because nobody enjoys being {left out|left out}.

paras.label: B
paras.text: New students need extra kindness. Starting at a new school can be {lonely|lonely}, so if you see a new face, {introduce|introduce} yourself: "Hi! My name is Max. What's your name?" Show them where things are in the classroom, and ask them to sit with you at lunch.

paras.label: C
paras.text: Respect also means listening when classmates answer questions. Never laugh if someone gives the wrong answer, and don't make strange faces. Instead, stay quiet while they speak and {encourage|encourage} them afterwards with words like "Good job!" or "Great answer!"

paras.label: D
paras.text: Teachers {deserve|deserve} good manners too, both in class and in the {corridors|corridors}. Look your teacher in the eye and {greet|greet} them: "Hello, Mr Berg. How are you?" It might {make their day|make their day}! If your teacher asks how you are, don't just {mumble|mumble}; answer clearly: "I'm great, thanks for asking!"

paras.label: E
paras.text: Finally, if you need to leave the classroom, for example to go to the toilet, ask first: "May I {be excused|be excused}, please?" Wait until the teacher says it is okay before you go.

parts.title: Part 1 · Which paragraph?
parts.instr: Đoạn nào (A–E) chứa thông tin dưới đây?

items.label: A paragraph about a student who is not part of a group
items.why: Đoạn A: *someone sitting alone… being left out.*

items.label: A paragraph that suggests helping someone find their way around
items.why: Đoạn B: *Show them where things are in the classroom.*

items.label: A paragraph that explains what to do when a classmate answers incorrectly
items.why: Đoạn C: *Never laugh if someone gives the wrong answer.*

items.label: A paragraph that describes how to say hello to an adult at school
items.why: Đoạn D: *Hello, Mr Berg. How are you?*

items.label: A paragraph that gives the exact words to ask permission to leave
items.why: Đoạn E: *May I be excused, please?*

parts.title: Part 2 · Reading comprehension
parts.instr: Chọn đáp án đúng hoặc True / False.

questions.q: Why should you invite someone who is sitting alone to join you?
options: The teacher will give you a prize.
Groups need more than four people.
They might help with your homework.

questions.q: According to paragraph B, you should only talk to new students in the classroom.
questions.why: Sai. Còn mời họ ngồi cùng *at lunch*.

questions.q: What should you do while a classmate is answering a question?
options: Laugh if the answer is wrong.

questions.q: Why does the writer say that greeting a teacher "might make their day"?
options: It could make the teacher feel happy.
Teachers need help with their work.
It makes the school day shorter.
questions.why: **Make someone's day** = khiến ai vui cả ngày.

questions.q: If a teacher asks how you are, you should answer clearly.
Which is the best title for the whole text?
questions.why: Bài nói cách cư xử với bạn học và thầy cô.

parts.title: Part 3 · Picture tasks
parts.instr: Quan sát tranh minh hoạ trong sách và trả lời.

questions.q: Grace is speaking to a boy at lunch. Who is the boy most likely to be?
questions.why: Grace giới thiệu tên và mời ăn trưa – đúng lời khuyên cho học sinh mới (đoạn B).
questions.alt: A girl says: Hi, my name is Grace. Would you like to join us for lunch?

questions.q: How will the boy probably feel after Grace's invitation?
questions.why: Lời mời giúp bạn mới bớt cô đơn, không bị *left out*.
questions.alt: A girl says: Hi, my name is Grace. Would you like to join us for lunch?

questions.q: What is the boy probably doing?
options: greeting his teacher in the corridor
asking to be excused from class
questions.why: Hành lang có tủ đồ, cậu bé nhìn thầy → chào hỏi (đoạn D).
questions.alt: A boy with a school bag looks up and talks to a male teacher in a corridor with lockers

parts.title: Part 4 · Gapped text
parts.instr: Đọc đoạn văn ngắn và chọn câu phù hợp cho mỗi chỗ trống. Có 2 câu thừa.
parts.text: On my first day at a new school, I didn't know anyone. [1] At lunchtime, a girl from my class walked over to me. [2] By the end of the week, we had become best friends. [3]
options: I stood in a corner of the playground, feeling lonely.
"Hi, I'm Lan. Would you like to sit with us?" she asked with a smile.
Now, whenever I see a new student, I try to do the same for them.
She laughed at my answer and walked away.
I asked the teacher if I could be excused.

items.why: Không quen ai → đứng một mình, cô đơn.
Lan đến và mời ngồi cùng – dẫn đến tình bạn ở câu sau.
Kết: bạn ấy làm lại điều tốt cho học sinh mới khác.

parts.title: Part 5 · Words in context
parts.instr: Đoán nghĩa của từ/cụm từ dựa vào ngữ cảnh.

questions.q: *…nobody enjoys being left out* (A). If you are **left out**, you are…
questions.why: **Left out** = bị gạt ra, không được tham gia.

questions.q: *…don't just mumble; answer clearly* (D). To **mumble** is to…
questions.why: Từ đối lập *answer clearly* giúp đoán: nói lầm bầm.

questions.q: *May I be excused, please?* (E). You say this when you want…
questions.why: Hỏi xin phép ra khỏi lớp (ví dụ đi vệ sinh).
